title: Cleaner Glass
description: Enjoy crystal-clear views with **Cleaner Glass**! This vanilla-friendly resource pack removes distracting glass streaks and borders while keeping Minecraft's original style intact.
body:
# Cleaner Glass

Tired of glass textures blocking your beautiful builds? **Cleaner Glass** gives Minecraft a cleaner, more polished look by reducing the distracting lines and borders on glass blocks while staying true to the vanilla aesthetic.

Whether you're building a modern house, a massive base, an aquarium, or a greenhouse, this pack lets you enjoy clear views without changing the rest of the game's art style.

## Features

* ✨ Cleaner, less distracting glass textures
* 🎮 100% vanilla-friendly appearance
* 🏠 Perfect for modern builds and large windows
* 🔍 Improves visibility through glass
* ⚡ Lightweight with no performance impact
* 📦 Easy to install and compatible with most resource packs

If you're looking for a simple visual upgrade that keeps Minecraft feeling like Minecraft, **Cleaner Glass** is the perfect choice.

Thank you for downloading! If you enjoy the pack, consider leaving a favorite or review—it helps the project grow and supports future updates.
